manifest.name: @lightcheng/dsh-strata
manifest.description: Strata Context: layered, restorable context management for DeepSeek Harness. Deterministic tail cuts, model-written folds, a local archive, and search.
manifest.author: Light Cheng (https://github.com/light-cheng)

bundle.text:
# Strata Context (@lightcheng/dsh-strata) bundle patch.
# Host stock stays disabled so this engine can register ctx.compaction.
# If the engine cannot load, shell.js falls back to the stock engine.
- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true
- insert:
    - id: compaction-strata
      name: '@lightcheng/dsh-strata'
      config:
        auto: true
        # These values are also copied onto the web preset engine by gate.js.
        thresholdRatio: 0.8
        headroomTokens: 65536
        retainTokens: 8192
        compactionRetries: 0
    - id: strata-gate
      name: '@lightcheng/dsh-strata/gate'
    - id: strata-tools
      name: '@lightcheng/dsh-strata/tools'

readme.text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Layered, restorable context management for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Repository: Old context is not thrown away. It sinks through layers, like sediment, and every layer can be brought back:

```text
original text (L0) → tool cards (L1) → model-written folds T1–T3 (L2) → local archive (L3)
                                                    DSH official summary as the last resort (L∞)
```

- **L1 tool cards**: deterministic, no model call, cut at every turn end.
- **L2 folds**: the model writes its own summaries of older ranges, and folds can be folded again (T1 → T2 → T3). When the model ignores the reminders, Strata folds the oldest work itself into an automatic digest.
- **L3 archive**: every original is saved locally before anything is replaced; `decompress` and `search_context` bring it back.

- **Deterministic tool cards (L1)**: at the end of each turn, the newest finished stretch of tool output is replaced by a card that keeps errors, commands, exit codes and archive pointers. No model call; the bytes before the cut stay identical, so the prefix cache keeps hitting.
- **Model-written folds in three tiers (L2)**: the model calls `compress` with a range from `strata_status` and its own summary. A range that contains earlier folds becomes the next tier, up to T3. Folds are validated immediately and land together at turn end.
- **Cost-aware landing**: before a fold lands, Strata weighs the one-time cache miss against the tokens it saves for the rest of the session. A small or unprofitable fold waits, and the tool result says so in its first line; above 75 % of the window folds land regardless.
- **Tier-by-tier recovery**: `decompress` walks T3 → T2 → T1 → card → original one level at a time, or straight to the originals with `full: true`; `toFile: true` writes large restores to `.strata/restore/`.
- **Local search**: `search_context` runs BM25 keyword search (CJK bigrams included) over fold summaries, card originals and tool output, and shows each hit's expansion path, e.g

```text
turn in progress
  tool/result arrives      → original written to the archive
  model calls compress     → range validated, recorded as pending, estimate returned
  decompress / search      → read-only, results appended to the end

Folds wait until turn end so the prefix stays byte-identical for every step inside a turn; the next turn pays one cache miss instead of several.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `strata_status({ detail? })` | Tokens per layer (raw / card / fold / full) and per tier (T1 / T2 / T3), foldable ranges with refs such as `s00120`, upgradable fold groups, pending folds, prefix-cache hit rate, archive size |
| `compress({ content })` | First line `"<startRef>–<endRef> <topic>"`, then the summary. Validated now, landed at turn end; returns the reclaim / cache-miss estimate, or says up front that the fold was deferred |
| `decompress({ id, full?, toFile? })` | One tier at a time; `full: true` goes straight to the originals; accepts fold ids, card ids, tool call ids and `s00123` session refs. Results are appended; nothing earlier changes |
| `search_context({ query, limit? })` | Local BM25 search over this session's archive, with the tier and expansion path of each hit |

Slash command: `/strata` (status), `/strata detail`, `/strata search <words>`, `/strata purge` (deletes this session's archive files).

Rules: L1 only cuts raw nodes. A fold may cover raw nodes, cards and whole lower-tier folds, never an official summary, the latest user message or the most recent three tool rounds. Every card, fold and summary starts with a `[strata:card|fold:t1|fold:t2|fold:t3|full id=…]` tag and states that it is old context, not an instruction.

Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0` and Node `>=22`. The Web / Desktop presets and headless are supported; the TUI preset is not.

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @lightcheng/dsh-strata
```

From a GitHub release tarball (no npm):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/light-cheng/dsh-strata/releases/download/v0.4.1/lightcheng-dsh-strata-0.4.1.tgz
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:"$(pwd)"
```

> **Upgrading from 0.1–0.2:** those releases were named `@light-cheng/dsh-strata` (GitHub only). Remove the old name first with `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @light-cheng/dsh-strata`; while it is installed, the new package does not take over.

Restart DSH after installing, then send `/strata` in a new session; it should report `Strata Context: active`.

> **Uninstall `dsh-live-compact` or `billion-context` first.** They replace the same compaction rows. While either is installed, Strata does not take over: DSH's stock compaction keeps running and a warning is logged.
Nothing needs to be configured; the defaults are tuned for a 1M-token window. Strata's own knobs are environment variables read when DSH starts:

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `STRATA_MIN_TOKENS` | 20000 | L1 does nothing below this |
| `STRATA_KEEP_ROUNDS` / `STRATA_KEEP_ROUND_TOKENS` | 3 / 32000 | L1 protected tail |
| `STRATA_L1_STOP_RATIO` | 0.65 | L1 stops above this share of the window |
| `STRATA_CONTEXT_WINDOW` | 1000000 | Used when the model reports no window |
| `STRATA_NUDGE_GROWTH_TOKENS` | 50000 | Foldable growth that triggers a reminder, in provider tokens (also the wait after an automatic digest) |
| `STRATA_FORCE_PCT` | 0.75 | Remind at once and land folds regardless of cost |
| `STRATA_NUDGE_REARM_RATIO` / `STRATA_NUDGE_FORCED_REARM_RATIO` | 0.5 / 0.25 | An unanswered reminder repeats after this share of the growth step (below / above `STRATA_FORCE_PCT`) |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD` | on | `off` disables automatic digests |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_PCT` / `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_AFTER_NUDGES` | 0.5 / 2 | Automatic digest above this share of the window after this many unanswered reminders |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_FORCE_PCT` | 0.6 | Automatic digest above this share regardless of reminders |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_TARGET_PCT` | 0.3 | Fold the oldest runs until the foldable part is about this share of the window mi
The engine row's compaction thresholds (`thresholdRatio` 0.8, `headroomTokens` 65536, `retainTokens` 8192) can be overridden in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `compaction-strata` id.

- Folds land at the **end of a turn**, automatic digests too. Inside one very long turn L2 cannot relieve pressure; DSH's own threshold then triggers the official summary (L∞), with the span archived first.
- Automatic digests are extractive: details beyond the first line of each tool result are only in the archive, so the model needs `decompress` or `search_context` to get them back.
- L1 cards are cut at turn end too, so a fold over a short, already-carded task reclaims little and may be deferred by the cost check. That is intended: in long sessions one fold covers many cards.
- The TUI preset is not supported; forked sessions cannot read the parent session's archive yet.

```bash
npm install
npm test
npm run check
```

54 unit tests cover L1 cuts, fold validation and landing, T1–T3 tiers, tier-by-tier `decompress`, search, the cost estimate, per-preset takeover, the stock fallback, and the dock's activity record and status route. `node eval/run.mjs` prints the real-model evaluation plan; `--run` executes it in isolated `DSH_HOME`s under `eval/.work/`. Results with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash are recorded in [`docs/design.md`](docs/design.md) §11.10.

- Originals are written to `<DSH_HOME>/strata/<session>/` (default `~/.dsh/strata/`), directories `0700`, files `0600`, 128 MB in total by default.
- Everything stays on this machine. Strata makes no network requests and no extra model calls of its own; folds are written by the session's own model as ordinary tool calls.
- The dock reads `GET /dsh-strata/gui/status?session=…` on DSH's own Web server, behind the same access check as every DSH route. It returns token counts and event kinds only, never message text or archive paths.
- Superseded runtime-context snapshots (for example DSH-Mem0's recalled memories) are never archived; they are replaced by a short placeholder, so deleting a memory in Mem0 leaves no copy in Strata's archive.
- System prompts are never archived; they are rebuilt on every request, and a one-line `[system prompt omitted]` marks their place, so the archive keeps no copy of, for example, DSH-Mem0's profile.
- Archives written by 0.3.0 next to DSH-Mem0 may still hold recalled memories or the Mem0 profile. On the first start after upgrading, Strata scrubs them once: runtime-context snapshots and `<mem0-relevant-memories>` blocks become the placeholder, `<mem0-us

- **[dsh-live-compact](https://github.com/MerkyorLynn/dsh-live-compact)** by Merkyor (MIT). Strata's L1 layer, archive rotation, prune guard and preset gate are a fork of version 1.0.6 (commit `768eff9`); its copyright notice is kept in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).
- **[billion-context](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context)** by ranxianglei. Strata borrows its ideas: model-driven restorable folds, the `compress` / `decompress` / `search_context` tool shape, growth and pressure reminders, minimum-benefit batching. No billion-context code or prompt text is included.
Release notes are bilingual with English first: [RELEASE.md](RELEASE.md).

[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的分层、可还原上下文管理插件。 仓库： 旧上下文不会被直接扔掉。它像沉积层一样一层层往下沉，每一层都能取回： ```text 原文（L0）→ 工具卡片（L1）→ 模型写的折叠摘要 T1–T3（L2）→ 本地存档（L3） DSH 官方整段摘要兜底（L∞） ```

- **L1 工具卡片**：确定性，不调模型，每轮结束时切。
- **L2 折叠摘要**：模型自己给较早的范围写摘要，摘要还能再折叠（T1 → T2 → T3）。模型不理会提醒时，Strata 自己把最早的内容折成自动摘录。
- **L3 本地存档**：任何内容被替换之前，原文都先存到本机；`decompress` 和 `search_context` 可以取回。

- **确定性工具卡片（L1）**：每轮结束时，把最新一段已完成的工具输出换成卡片，卡片保留报错、命令、退出码和存档指针。不调模型，切点之前的字节不变，前缀缓存继续命中。
- **三级模型折叠（L2）**：模型调用 `compress`，给出 `strata_status` 里的范围和自己写的摘要。范围里包含已有折叠时，自动成为更高一级，最高 T3。折叠当场校验，本轮结束时一起落地。
- **按代价决定是否落地**：落地前，Strata 估算一次性的缓存未命中和之后每次请求省下的 token。太小或不划算的折叠会等一等，工具结果第一行就会说明「已推迟」；上下文超过窗口 75% 时不论代价都落地。
- **逐级还原**：`decompress` 一次往回走一级：T3 → T2 → T1 → 卡片 → 原文；`full: true` 直接取原文；`toFile: true` 把大段内容写到 `.strata/restore/`。
- **本地检索**：`search_context` 用 BM25 关键词检索（支持中日韩双字切分），范围包括各级摘要、卡片原文和工具输出；每条结果标出所在级别和展开路径，例如 `f9(T3) → f4(T2) → f2(T1) → raw call-7`。
- **提醒看的是对的数**：L1 会把总量压低，所以 Strata 看的是「可折叠 token」。可折叠内容增长 50K 真实（服务商）token 时提醒模型（本地估算按本会话测得的比例换算，`strata_status` 会显示这个比例），一轮中的任何一步都可以提醒，不必等新消息。提醒没有得到回应时，再增长 25K 会再提醒一次（超过窗口 75% 后是 12.5K）。
- **模型不折叠时自动摘录**：轮末时，如果上下文超过窗口 50% 且已有两次提醒没有回应（或超过 60%，不论提醒），Strata 不调用模型，从最早的可折叠内容折起，直到可折叠部分约为“窗口减去固定开销”的 30%（固定开销指系统提示、工具定义等任何折叠都动不了的部分）。一次摘录落地后，要再积累 50K 可折叠内容（或上下文超过 75%）才会再折；剩下的只有固定或受保护的内容时，不再提议。每段摘录保留用户消息、助手回复的开头、每个工具调用的路径或命令及其第一行结果，以及错误；标签带 `auto=1`，正文写明由 Strata 生成。摘录和普通折叠一样先存档、可还原，不会覆盖当前的运行时上下文、最新的用户消息和受保护的尾部，也要通过同样的代价估算。模型挂起的折叠不会挡住它们：挂起的部分计入目标，摘录绕开它折。`strata_status` 会写上一次轮末做了什么（`Automatic fold at last turn end: …`）。`strata_status` 单独统计它们，浮标显示为「自动折叠」。

```text
本轮进行中
  工具结果到达             → 原文写进存档
  模型调用 compress        → 校验范围，记为待落地，返回估算
  decompress / 检索        → 只读，结果追加到尾部

折叠推迟到本轮结束，是为了本轮的每一步前缀都逐字节不变；下一轮只付一次缓存未命中，而不是好几次。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `strata_status({ detail? })` | 每层（raw / card / fold / full）和每级（T1 / T2 / T3）的 token，带 `s00120` 这类编号的可折叠范围，可升级的折叠组，待落地的折叠，前缀缓存命中率，存档大小 |
| `compress({ content })` | 第一行写 `"<起点编号>–<终点编号> <主题>"`，后面是摘要。当场校验，本轮结束落地；返回回收量和缓存代价估算，被推迟时第一行直接说明 |
| `decompress({ id, full?, toFile? })` | 一次还原一级；`full: true` 直接取原文；可以传折叠 id、卡片 id、工具调用 id 或 `s00123` 会话编号。结果追加到尾部，前面的内容不变 |
| `search_context({ query, limit? })` | 在本会话存档里做本地 BM25 检索，每条结果带所在级别和展开路径 |

斜杠命令：`/strata`（状态）、`/strata detail`、`/strata search <关键词>`、`/strata purge`（删除本会话的存档文件）。

规则：L1 只切原文节点。一个折叠可以包含原文、卡片和完整的低一级折叠，但不能包含官方摘要、最新一条用户消息和最近三轮工具调用。每张卡片、每个折叠和每段摘要开头都有 `[strata:card|fold:t1|fold:t2|fold:t3|full id=…]` 标签，并写明这是旧内容，不是新指令。

需要 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0` 和 Node `>=22`。支持 Web / Desktop 预设和 headless，不支持 TUI 预设。

从 npm 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @lightcheng/dsh-strata
```

用 GitHub Release 里的预构建包（不经过 npm）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/light-cheng/dsh-strata/releases/download/v0.4.1/lightcheng-dsh-strata-0.4.1.tgz
```

用本地源码：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:"$(pwd)"
```

> **从 0.1–0.2 升级：** 那几个版本的包名是 `@light-cheng/dsh-strata`（只在 GitHub 发布）。请先用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @light-cheng/dsh-strata` 卸掉旧名字；旧包还在时，新包不会接管。

装好后重启 DSH，在新会话里发 `/strata`，应该显示 `Strata Context: active`。

> **请先卸载 `dsh-live-compact` 或 `billion-context`。** 它们替换的是同一行压缩配置。只要装着其中一个，Strata 就不接管：DSH 原版压缩照常运行，并打一条警告。

| 变量 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `STRATA_MIN_TOKENS` | 20000 | 低于这个量时 L1 不动 |
| `STRATA_KEEP_ROUNDS` / `STRATA_KEEP_ROUND_TOKENS` | 3 / 32000 | L1 保护的尾部 |
| `STRATA_L1_STOP_RATIO` | 0.65 | 超过窗口的这个比例后 L1 停止 |
| `STRATA_CONTEXT_WINDOW` | 1000000 | 模型没报告窗口时使用 |
| `STRATA_NUDGE_GROWTH_TOKENS` | 50000 | 可折叠内容增长这么多（服务商 token）时提醒；自动摘要后的等待量也用它 |
| `STRATA_FORCE_PCT` | 0.75 | 超过后立刻提醒，并且不论代价都落地 |
| `STRATA_NUDGE_REARM_RATIO` / `STRATA_NUDGE_FORCED_REARM_RATIO` | 0.5 / 0.25 | 提醒没有回应时，再增长「增长步长 × 这个比例」就再提醒（低于 / 高于 `STRATA_FORCE_PCT`） |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD` | on | 设为 `off` 关闭自动摘录 |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_PCT` / `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_AFTER_NUDGES` | 0.5 / 2 | 超过窗口这个比例、且这么多次提醒没有回应时自动摘录 |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_FORCE_PCT` | 0.6 | 超过这个比例时不论提醒都自动摘录 |
| `STRATA_AUTO_FOLD_TARGET_PCT` | 0.3 | 从最早的内容折起，直到可折叠部分约为（窗口 − 固定开销）的这个比例（`strata_status` 显示固定开销） |
| `STRATA_AUTO_DIGEST_RATIO` | 0.12 | 一段摘录最多保留被折叠文字的这个比例（至少 1200 字符） |
| `STRATA_MIN_BENEFIT_TOKENS` / `STRATA_MIN_BENEFIT_RATIO` | 5000 / 0.01 | 最小折叠批量：`max(token 数, 窗口 × 比例)` |
| `STRATA_UPGRADE_BENEFIT_FACTOR` | 1.5 | 批量里有升级折叠时，最小批量乘这个系数 |
| `STRATA_PRICE_MISS` / `STRATA_PRICE_HIT` | 1 / 0.1 | 估算用的相对缓存价格 |
| `STRATA_EXPECTED_REQUESTS` | 自动 | 估算假设的剩余请求数 |
| `STR
引擎行的压缩阈值（`thresholdRatio` 0.8、`headroomTokens` 65536、`retainTokens` 8192）可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 `compaction-strata` 这个 id 覆盖。

- 折叠在**本轮结束时**才落地，自动摘录也一样。一轮特别长的任务里，L2 帮不上忙；这时由 DSH 自己的阈值触发官方整段摘要（L∞），触发前先存档。
- 自动摘录是摘抄式的：工具结果第一行之后的细节只在存档里，模型要用 `decompress` 或 `search_context` 取回。
- L1 卡片也是轮末切的。所以一个已经切成卡片的短任务再去折叠，回收很少，可能被代价估算推迟。这是有意的：长会话里一个折叠会覆盖很多张卡片。
- 不支持 TUI 预设；fork 出来的会话暂时读不到父会话的存档。

```bash
npm install
npm test
npm run check
```

54 个单元测试覆盖 L1 切卡、折叠的校验与落地、T1–T3 分级、逐级 `decompress`、检索、代价估算、各预设分别接管、回退到原版引擎，以及浮标的活动记录和状态接口。`node eval/run.mjs` 打印真实模型评测计划，加 `--run` 会在 `eval/.work/` 下的独立 `DSH_HOME` 里执行。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的结果记录在 [`docs/design.md`](docs/design.md) §11.10。

- 原文写在 `<DSH_HOME>/strata/<会话>/`（默认 `~/.dsh/strata/`），目录权限 `0700`，文件 `0600`，默认总量上限 128 MB。
- 所有内容都留在本机。Strata 自己不发网络请求，也不额外调用模型；折叠摘要由会话里的模型通过普通工具调用写出。
- 浮标读取的是 DSH 自己 Web 服务上的 `GET /dsh-strata/gui/status?session=…`，经过和其他 DSH 接口相同的访问校验；只返回 token 数和事件类型，不含消息原文和存档路径。
- 过期的运行时上下文快照（比如 DSH-Mem0 召回的记忆）不会存档，只换成一行很短的占位，所以在 Mem0 里删掉的记忆不会在 Strata 存档里留副本。
- 系统提示词从不存档：它每次请求都会重新生成，原位置只留一行 `[system prompt omitted]`，所以存档里不会有 DSH-Mem0 画像之类内容的副本。
- 0.3.0 和 DSH-Mem0 一起用时写下的存档里可能还留着召回的记忆或 Mem0 画像。升级后第一次启动时，Strata 会清理一次：运行时上下文快照和 `<mem0-relevant-memories>` 块换成占位，`<mem0-user-profile>` 块和官方摘要存档里的系统提示词段落也一并替换，其他内容不变；存档根目录里的 `.scrub-runtime-context-v2` 标记保证只执行一次。
- 卡片和折叠里只放存档 id，不放绝对路径。`/strata purge` 删除当前会话的存档。

- **[dsh-live-compact](https://github.com/MerkyorLynn/dsh-live-compact)**，作者 Merkyor（MIT）。Strata 的 L1 层、存档轮换、裁剪保护和预设改写，分叉自它的 1.0.6 版（commit `768eff9`）；版权声明保留在 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。
- **[billion-context](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context)**，作者 ranxianglei。Strata 借鉴了它的思路：模型驱动、可还原的折叠，`compress` / `decompress` / `search_context` 这套工具形态，增长和压力提醒，最小收益批量。没有包含 billion-context 的代码或提示词原文。
